WHAT: Full API integration reference for production-studio scripts

API KEYS NEEDED (5 total):
- GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY — all Google models
- KLING_API_KEY — KIE API pattern (not fal.ai)
- WAVESPEED_API_KEY — Kling lip-sync
- FREEPIK_API_KEY — Magnific + Skin Enhancer
- ELEVENLABS_API_KEY — voiceover

MODELS & ENDPOINTS:

Google AI (base: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{MODEL}:generateContent, header: x-goog-api-key):
- LLM cheap: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview ($0.25/$1.50 per 1M)
- LLM premium: gemini-3.1-pro-preview ($2/$12 per 1M)
- Image gen cheap: gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview (~$0.067/img)
- Image gen premium (Nano Banana Pro): gemini-3-pro-image-preview ($0.134–$0.24/img)
- Video fast: veo-3.1-fast-generate-001 (~$0.15/s, needs OAuth + Vertex)
- Video quality: veo-3.1-generate-001 ($0.40–$0.75/s)

Kling image-to-video (https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/jobs/createTask, Bearer auth):
- Cheap: kling-2.6/image-to-video ($0.35/5s mute, $0.70/5s audio)
- Premium: kling-3.0/image-to-video Pro (~$0.45/5s)
- Poll: GET https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/jobs/{task_id}

Kling LipSync (https://api.wavespeed.ai/api/v3/kwaivgi/kling-lipsync/audio-to-video, Bearer WAVESPEED_API_KEY):
- ~$0.10/5s, takes video URL + audio URL
- Poll: GET https://api.wavespeed.ai/api/v3/predictions/{id}/result

Freepik (header: x-freepik-api-key):
- Magnific upscale: POST https://api.freepik.com/v1/ai/image-upscaler-precision-v2
  Params: scale_factor:2, flavor:"sublime", sharpen:7, smart_grain:7, ultra_detail:30
- Skin Enhancer Faithful: POST https://api.freepik.com/v1/ai/skin-enhancer/faithful
  Params: sharpen:10, smart_grain:7, skin_detail:80 (200 credits/image)
- Both return task_id → poll for COMPLETED → generated[0].url

ElevenLabs (POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}, header: xi-api-key):
- Cheap: eleven_flash_v2_5 ($0.06/1K chars)
- Premium: eleven_multilingual_v2 ($0.12/1K chars)
- Response is raw MP3 bytes (no JSON wrapper)

GOTCHA: Veo 3.1 needs GCP OAuth (Bearer from gcloud), not the simple API key — different auth pattern
